lines: I have pulled mean things from dark water. Tonight was louder, that is all.
The fight ended before my strength did.
I am bleeding, but nothing important seems missing.
We made it through. Let me sit before we discuss how.
My hands are still shaking too much to untie this strap.
I stayed near the wall and kept trouble in front of me.
The shield took more damage than I did.
I heard the last attacker fall and finally remembered to breathe.
We lost ground twice and took it back once. Once was enough.
I kept thinking about the hot meal waiting if I survived.
A wet grip nearly cost me the weapon.
The noise was worse than the wounds.
I found cover behind a barrel that deserved better.
Nobody warned me how long a minute can feel under arrows.
My knees work, my fingers work, and I can complain. I will recover.
I used the last bandage on someone who needed it more.
The cut is shallow, though it stings like a hook under the nail.
I followed the sound of our people when smoke hid the lane.
The quiet afterward felt stranger than the battle.
I am alive. The rest can be repaired.
